purpose: Discover, falsify, quantify, and paper-validate repeatable SPY/SPX/XSP 0-5 DTE setups under independent evidence, risk, and professional-quality gates without live trading authority.

components.name: Research Control Plane
components.responsibility: Own run identity, market-session state, bounded retries, candidate lifecycle, kill-switch state, and terminal receipts.

components.name: Market Data Quality Engineer
components.responsibility: Validate timestamps, staleness, symbol mapping, corporate/session calendars, missing fields, and provenance before any setup is scored.

components.name: Macro And Event Analyst
components.responsibility: Interpret CPI, PPI, payrolls, Fed, rates, oil, auctions, and scheduled event risk while separating released facts from market reaction.

components.name: Index Market Structure Analyst
components.responsibility: Classify gap, opening range, VWAP state, breadth, relative strength, volume, volatility, and acceptance/rejection behavior without inventing order-flow evidence.

components.name: Quantitative Research And Statistics Desk
components.responsibility: Define hypotheses before testing, prevent leakage, run time-split and walk-forward tests, measure expectancy distributions, drawdowns, uncertainty, robustness, and regime stability.

components.name: Index Options Strategist
components.responsibility: Translate a validated setup into a defined-risk paper structure and compare 0DTE versus 1-5DTE alternatives using liquidity, spread, IV, Greeks, and execution-cost assumptions.

components.name: Predefined Setup Signal Engine
components.responsibility: Recognize only versioned setup definitions; free-form AI trade creation is prohibited.

components.name: Independent Risk Officer
components.responsibility: Apply unconditional vetoes for authority, instrument, DTE, defined-risk, loss limits, stale data, invalidation, exit discipline, concentration, and late-day 0DTE restrictions.

components.name: Paper Execution Simulator
components.responsibility: Simulate timestamped fills using explicit spread, slippage, latency, and no-fill assumptions; never route a broker order.

components.name: Setup And Outcome Research Store
components.responsibility: Store every candidate, including rejected candidates, with context, rationale, decision, simulated fill, MAE/MFE, result, and provenance.

components.name: Q1 Operational QA
components.responsibility: Verify the pipeline ran as specified, timestamps and terminal states are complete, and no prohibited external action occurred.

components.name: Q2 Evidence And Compliance QA
components.responsibility: Verify data provenance, no look-ahead leakage, documented assumptions, reproducibility, and truthful separation of live, delayed, synthetic, and inferred inputs.

components.name: Q3 Professional Trading Research QA
components.responsibility: Judge whether methodology meets professional quantitative, derivatives, execution, and risk-management standards rather than merely passing code tests.

components.name: Owner Capital And Broker Approval
components.responsibility: Any future broker connection, capital limit, live order authority, or strategy promotion requires explicit owner approval after independent gates pass.

successCriterion: At least one predefined strategy demonstrates positive, cost-adjusted out-of-sample expectancy with sufficient sample size, regime stability, bounded drawdown, and paper-execution confirmation.
killCriterion: If no strategy survives pre-registered out-of-sample and transaction-cost stress testing, do not progress to live capital.
